policy: Individual identities are A=Aa, C=Ab (inner pair), and outer B. Adopt dynamical masses and component Johnson V; preserve uncertain bolometric estimates as estimates. Never convert blended system temperatures or atmospheric fits into individual measurements. Preserve all earlier catalog/effective records and their provenance.

mass_solar.method: Individual dynamical mass from the simultaneous inner/outer orbital fit; published orbital parallax 293.6 +/-0.9 mas.

absolute_mag.method: Published individual absolute V from system photometry, flux ratios and parallax; baseline photometry, not a dated flare snapshot.
absolute_mag.caveat: A/C flux separation uses the approximate spectroscopic light ratio; C retains its large published error. These values are V-band magnitudes, not bolometric luminosities.

spectral_type.scope: Individual EZ Aqr A; A=Aa, C=Ab, outer B. A colon denotes an estimated subtype, not a measured temperature.

temperature_k.decision: The previous 3060 K unresolved M5V class estimate is not an individual temperature. Do not infer component temperatures from tentative spectral subtypes or blended SED fits.

radius_solar.decision: No secure individual radius adopted. Do not derive a radius from an uncertain luminosity and a spectral-class temperature.

luminosity_solar.caveat: Published approximate bolometric luminosity marked with a colon; no numerical uncertainty supplied. Converted from log10 L/Lsun; not a new precision measurement or a value derived from V magnitude.

row.name: EZ Aquarii A
row.notes: System position from J2000 direction and 293.60 mas parallax compiled by Torres et al. (2010). Temperature is the unresolved M5V system class estimate. Motion: Segransan et al. (2000), Table 2, gives the shared EZ Aquarii ABC systemic radial velocity V0 = -50.08 +/- 0.01 km/s. The uncertainty is the published orbital-fit uncertainty on V0. Combined with the retained system position, parallax and proper motion, this supplies approximate system bulk motion for A, B and C; individual orbital velocities and orbital phase are not modeled. Frozen J2000 positions are retained.
